cycle1-MECHANISM-THE-REUSABLE-RESULT. An uncast resolver is a BEHAVIOURAL defect only where a caller performs PYTHON ATTRIBUTE ACCESS (or hasattr) on the resolved object for a member not on ICmObject -- pythonnet exposes only members declared on the static interface the wrapper was built against. Passing that same bare wrapper as an ARGUMENT to a strongly-typed .NET method is a different axis: the CLR binds on the object's RUNTIME type, which does implement the concrete interface, so no cast is needed. __GetEnvironmentObject's two callers only do the second thing (PhoneEnvRC.Add/.Remove).
